title: Chapter 416: Black Dog And Cat
content:
Chapter 416: Black Dog And Cat

Lu Xue let out a light breath, then showed a gentle smile to Jing on the side.

"Xiao Jing, has anyone come back recently?"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Xiaojing touched her chin, thought for a while, then shook her head and said, "No, Sister Lu Xue, those people you said have not come back, and the city lord's mansion has not changed much until now."

Before Lu Xue left Huangcheng, she specifically instructed Yueming and Jing to look at Huangcheng. Although she knew that Master and others would not come back so soon, she still had some thoughts in her heart.

Lu Xue no longer asked, but took Jing towards the direction of the city lord's mansion.

As Lu Xue went deeper into the deserted city, more and more people in the deserted city began to say hello to Lu Xue.

Lu Xue smiled and nodded in response to this.

In a dense bamboo forest.

The cramped footsteps sounded.

A man in luxury ran towards this place hurriedly, until he arrived in front of the bamboo forest, the man took a breath, sorted out his emotions, and spoke respectfully: "Old ancestor, Miss Lu Xue is back."

The bamboo forest was silent for a moment.

The next moment, a squeak.

The bamboo door opened, and an old man dressed in cloth and disheveled hair walked out of the house.

He took a step forward and instantly appeared in front of the man.

A huge sense of oppression came, and the man breathed heavily, lowering his head tightly, not daring to look directly into the old man's eyes.

He is extremely humble now, but outside, he is one of the giants in the desert city. As long as he stamps his feet, the entire desert city will shake except the city lord's mansion.

All of this is because he is the head of the Li family, one of the three major tribes in the inner city. The ancestor of the Li family stood in front of him. As long as the ancestor of the Li family said, he could go down from this position.

Therefore, when facing his ancestors, he can only be respectful.

"You said, Miss Lu Xue is back?"

The low voice of the ancestor of the Li family sounded and came into the ears of the head of the Li family, which made the head of the Li family kneel on the ground.

Just a sound made him unable to bear it.

After so many years, the strength of the Li family ancestor is probably unfathomable.

"Ancestor, everything I said to me is true. Miss Lu Xue is really back!"

The head of the Li family looked slightly pale and his whole body was trembling slightly.

Seeing this, the ancestor of the Li family stroked his beard and suddenly burst into laughter.

"Okay, okay, hahahahaha."

As he said that, the ancestor of the Li family patted the head of the Li family on the shoulder again, and then left with a laugh.

The head of the Li family was gasping for breath until his ancestor disappeared, and then he recovered. He reached out and touched the shoulder that he had just been patted by his ancestor, revealing a dismal and stolen one. A happy smile.

At the same time, a similar scene also happened in the other two major tribes in the deserted city.

At this point, the entire inner city began to get restless.

For the three major tribes of Huangcheng, except for the city lord's mansion, almost all other forces of all sizes and small have maintained their highest respect.

There are not many family systems in the deserted city.

But only three tribes can be called large tribes.

The Nangong family, who had already joined the deserted city and luckily entered the inner city, did not have this ability.

More and more people came out of seclusion and finally attracted the attention of the city lord's mansion.

Twist!

The sound of uniform steps came from afar.

Everyone looked at each other and saw a strong man wearing unified dark black clothing with dark golden patterns engraved on it coming towards this place.

The leader was wearing a black dog mask, and the long sword on his waist trembled slightly. The whole person seemed to be a big knife that he would wave at any time, which made everyone present unable to help but retreat slightly.

The Wilderness Guard!

However, before this was over, the surrounding space suddenly began to become darker. Then, the darkness twisted, and figures emerged out of thin air. The degree of concealment of these existences and their control over the way of space even exceeded that of the Shadow Clan.

The appearance of this group of people made everyone present pale.

Even though they are all from the inner city and live freely on weekdays, they are still afraid of such an organization.

This is the intelligence department of Huangcheng, hidden in the dark organization - root.

The leader is wearing a cat mask on his head, his breath is completely restrained, and his whole body seems to be falling leaves in the wind, drifting with the wind.

Seeing this person, everyone quickly lowered their heads and did not dare to look at them.

At this time, both the Black Dog Mask and the Tag Cat Mask walked slowly towards Lu Xue.

Immediately afterwards, the two of them knelt on one knee at the same time, "I have seen Miss Lu Xue!"

Lu Xue looked at the two of them without saying a word.

The scene suddenly fell into ghostly silence.

Everyone even forgot to breathe at this moment, and they didn't dare to breathe.

The two people standing in front of Lu Xue were wearing masks and could not see their expressions.

Lu Xue's eyes were calm.

When she just returned to the Chaos Realm, the root of Huangcheng already knew that she was back.

But until now, when she came to the inner city and was about to set foot in the city lord's mansion, Gen and Huangwei came barely.

She was very dissatisfied.

If these two people could come to see her the moment she stepped into the deserted city, she wouldn't say anything, but now it's really late.

In full view of everyone, Lu Xue shook her head, ignored the two of them, and continued to walk forward.

The two of them were still kneeling on their original positions until Lu Xue walked away, and then they slowly stood up and looked towards Lu Xue.

"Miss Lu Xue, there are many things in the deserted city. Please forgive me for your rudeness."

The black dog mask bowed to Lu Xue, and his voice was very respectful.

The cat mask on the side nodded and said, "Miss Lu Xue, please let me follow you, so that you can understand the current situation faster."

Faced with the two of them’s sincere requests, Lu Xue sighed softly.

Is this the one that Awei and An Xing found?

I'm really a little disappointed.

However, this cannot be the two of them, after all, people's hearts will become.

Now that all those people in the deserted city have left, Lu Daosheng and her are not here, I'm afraid that these two people will have the final say in the entire deserted city. With such great power, it's hard not to change one's mind.

Thinking of this, Lu Xue quickly felt relieved.

Lu Xue patted her hands gently, then pointed at the two of them and said, "Take back the power of these two people and investigate it carefully."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, both of them couldn't help but be stunned. Although their faces were a little ugly, they felt a little sarcastic.

The entire Huangwei and the roots of the Huangcheng City are their people, and this power cannot be given up just by saying it.

So many years have passed, and the entire wasteland city is under the management of the two of them.

The two of them are confident and familiar with the foundation of Huangcheng.

But these are just the fantasies of the two of them after all.

As Lu Xue's voice fell.

Two figures appeared beside both of them at the same time.

The next moment, heavy pressure like a mountain surged out, pressing the two of them to kneel on the ground without any surprise.

There was a rumbling sound.

The smoke of gunpowder dissipated, and the two of them looked ugly and were directly suppressed.

The two Huangwei and two root members were subdued.
